fail_on_untested_version.description: Whether to fail if the Dokku version has not been tested with this provider. Defaults to true. Can be set via DOKKU_FAIL_ON_UNTESTED_VERSION environment variable.

skip_known_hosts_check.description: Whether to skip SSH known hosts verification. Defaults to false. Can be set via DOKKU_SKIP_KNOWN_HOSTS_CHECK environment variable.

ssh_cert.description: Either a path to the SSH private key for connecting to your Dokku server OR the source for an SSH key directly. Can be set via DOKKU_SSH_CERT environment variable.

ssh_host.description: The hostname of your Dokku server. Can be set via DOKKU_SSH_HOST environment variable.

ssh_passphrase.description: An optional passphrase to be used in conjunction with the provided SSH key.

ssh_port.description: The SSH port of your Dokku server. Defaults to 22. Can be set via DOKKU_SSH_PORT environment variable.

ssh_user.description: The SSH user to connect to your Dokku server. Defaults to 'dokku'. Can be set via DOKKU_SSH_USER environment variable.

buildpacks.description: List of buildpacks to be used when deploying the application. These can be URLs to custom buildpacks or shorthand names for official Heroku buildpacks.

config_vars.description: Environment variables to set for the application. These are exposed to the application at runtime.

domains.description: List of domains to be associated with the application.

locked.description: (Not yet implemented) Whether the application is locked for deployment. When true, deploys to this application will be blocked.

name.description: The name of the Dokku application.

nginx_bind_address_ipv4.description: The IPv4 address that nginx will bind to for this application. Defaults to '0.0.0.0'.

nginx_bind_address_ipv6.description: The IPv6 address that nginx will bind to for this application. Defaults to '::'.

ports.description: Set of port mappings for the application. Each mapping should be in the format 'scheme:hostPort:containerPort' (e.g., 'https:443:8080').

block.description: Manages a Dokku application. This resource enables the configuration and deployment of applications on a Dokku host, supporting environment variables, domains, buildpacks, and port mapping.

name.description: The name of the ClickHouse service.

stopped.description: Whether the ClickHouse service is stopped. When true, the database service will not be running but data will be preserved.

block.description: Manages a ClickHouse service in Dokku. Requires the ClickHouse Dokku plugin to be installed.

alias.description: Alternative environment variable name to use in exposing credentials to the app.

app.description: The name of the Dokku application that will be linked to the ClickHouse service.

query_string.description: Additional connection parameters to append to the service URL environment variables as a query string.

service.description: The name of the ClickHouse service to link to the application.

block.description: Links a Dokku ClickHouse service to an application, creating a connection between them and injecting the ClickHouse connection details into the application's environment variables.

expose_on.description: Network address and port to expose the service on. Format is 'host:port' (e.g. '0.0.0.0:8085'). If not specified, the service remains unexposed.

image_version.description: The version of MySQL to use. If not specified, Dokku will use its default version.
